segments.title: Pepito Station Sign-On & Studio Tour

segments.title: Content Warning Gameplay Marathon

lore_notes.fact: Case and Kendall have moved to a new residence/studio location.
Kendall announced she has quit her job (both teams at work).
Case and Christian were invited to Disneyland in two weeks; Case declined.
Case expects to play with Gina Ovely and Casem on Friday.
Case confirms Friday return for news broadcast and potential gaming with Ovali, Gina, Goldenboy, Casem.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired a substitute broadcast after the anchor and executive producer relocated studios. Case Blackwell and Kendelle hosted a marathon co-op session of Content Warning with a rotating crew of friends, punctuated by multiple raids and subscription-driven ice-dunk forfeits. The broadcast concluded with a raid to mutual friend Danny Plots and a confirmation of Friday's return to standard news programming alongside a planned Repo session.
